thread:
emily (Design): quick UX flag — users find the export affordance in the error tooltip confusing. thinking: remove export from tooltip, surface a single 'Export trace' control in the drilldown header. thoughts?

raj (Product): +1. header makes export discoverable. keep a tiny inline 'Export view' in tooltip for power users (kebab menu). avoid 'snapshot' wording.

maria (Eng): FYI, header export requires server to capture filters + time range at click time. adds ~200ms backend work. acceptable?

liam (A11y): accessibility notes: export button must be keyboard reachable, have aria-label including request id e.g. "Export trace (req 7b3f)"; modal must be role=dialog and return focus after close. Contrast check required.

emily (Design): proposed tooltip copy: "Error context — top frames and request metadata. Expand to view stack or copy request id." Header CTA: "Export trace" + chevron for JSON/HAR. microcopy: "Includes filters, time range, and visible stack frames."

raj (Product): suggest default = JSON, HAR opt-in. add keyboard shortcut Shift+E and show in command palette.

maria (Eng): Shift+E OK, will scan conflicts. backend will attach small metadata blob (error class, correlation id). HAR behind opt-in.

emily (Design): placement decision: put Export on right grouped with filters/time selector for locality. ensure DOM order favors keyboard nav.

liam (A11y): agree. DOM order before overflow menu, button must meet 4.5:1. I'll run quick checklist when preview is up.

ui-bot: preview deployed at https://ui-stage.redwood.ai/trace-export-170777 10 — includes export modal and keyboard demo.

raj (Product): thanks — I'll update the copy doc and schedule a 15m sign-off tomorrow 10:30am.

emily (Design): works for me.

maria (Eng): works.

liam (A11y): works. I'll bring the checklist. :thumbsup:
